comments.author: graphe
comments.story: Why Is the Sea So Hot?
comments.why: Discusses climate models being too cold due to clouds
comments.text: I watched Sabina Hossenfelder talk about historical predictive models being wrong and too cold on their predictions due to the way they looked at the clouds and the scattering of the light (quantifying the amount of water vapor in the clouds). [VIDEO] Climate scientists are disagreeing over the hot climate models. This is not a debate on the human effects, simply the way to interpret the data.
